newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria names five firms for quick privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria names five firms for quick privatisation.

text.p: Bulgaria's Privatisation Agency has identified five state companies for quick privatisation and plans to appoint advisers for their sale by the end of May.

The Agency named the companies as Dyuni tourist resort, Verila bio-products and polymers manufacturer, Agrobiochim bio-products and fertilisers company, Asarel, which extracts and processes non-ferrous metals, and drugs firm Antibiotic.

The five are the first of a list of 30 companies slated for quick sale. Privatisation will be a key source of income for the government after it is cut off from central bank lending under a currency board regime due to be introduced in June.
Under an agreement with the International Monetary Fund, Bulgaria has pledged to privatise all commercial enterprises and half its utilities within two years. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 981 4145
